title: Article with Contents
description: A long-form guide with a byline, a pull-out rule and a sticky table of contents that follows the reader.
summary: Editorial article with a scrollspy table of contents.
notes: The scrollspy enhancer sets aria-current="location" on the contents link of the section being read. Without JavaScript the contents stay plain anchor links and the article is unchanged.
Spying follows the page viewport. If the article sits in its own scroll container, add data-scrollspy-root pointing at it.
Author, figures and advice are sample copy; replace them with your own content.
